current_mission: Collect real student samples from the 3 current worksheets, then use them to test ScanGrade honestly.
north_star: Primary students scan completed worksheets on shared iPads; teachers review saved results only when needed.
next_best_move: Tony: have students fill out the 3 current worksheets with the new answer boxes, then send clear photos/scans back for testing.
plain_english_status: We have the current open-divider worksheet packet, reusable test fixtures, a preserved backend scaffold, and a working app/test path. The next truth test is still real student handwriting on the current sheets. Until those samples arrive, Codex should avoid changing OCR/capture logic and focus on safe verification, organization, and careful preservation.
needs_tony: Print or share the 3 current worksheets.
Have students complete them naturally, using their normal pencil/spacing.
Send the completed sheets back as clear photos/scans for OCR and iPad-path testing.
If possible, name files like sheet-a-student-01.jpg, sheet-b-student-01.jpg, and sheet-c-student-01.jpg.
blocked_or_risky: Main validation is blocked until real completed student sheets arrive.
OCR/capture/homography files contain large tracked modifications and should not be changed casually.
Debug crop export specs create local artifacts when run, so only run them intentionally.

cards.title: Collect 3 completed worksheets
cards.summary: Students fill out Addition Within 20, Subtraction Within 20, and Mixed Within 50 using the new answer boxes.
cards.detail: These samples become the honest test set for the next OCR/capture pass. Normal student handwriting is more valuable than perfect samples.

cards.title: Send photos/scans back to Codex
cards.summary: Clear images of each completed sheet, preferably including a few natural imperfections.
cards.detail: Good enough: full page visible, corners included, not badly blurred. Perfect lighting is not required.

cards.title: Test real student samples
cards.summary: Run the uploaded sheets through the current pipeline and report what works, what fails, and why.
cards.detail: Use docs/STUDENT_SAMPLE_INTAKE.md. Codex should translate failures into plain English and avoid patching OCR/capture until the failure mode is clear.

cards.title: Do not tune OCR blind
cards.summary: OCR/capture changes should wait for real sample evidence or a reproducible failing test.
cards.detail: This protects the currently promising MacBook/upload behavior and avoids overfitting to imagined problems.

cards.title: Decide pilot threshold
cards.summary: After real samples are tested, decide what is good enough for a small classroom pilot.
cards.detail: This should be based on scan success rate, retry behavior, and teacher-review usefulness.

cards.title: Private Mission Control v1
cards.summary: Local private dashboard exists with mission, board, decisions, worksheets, validation, and docs.
cards.detail: Still being refined for clarity and Tailscale access.

cards.title: Active Teacher Mode tests fixed
cards.summary: Active Teacher/debug specs now open Teacher Mode before expecting Runtime Self-Test.
cards.detail: test-app, test-upload, test-ocr, verify-single-pipeline, and test-upload-real all passed with the current harness. No production app logic was touched.

cards.title: Student sample intake checklist
cards.summary: Plain-English intake instructions now exist for the real open-divider worksheet photos.
cards.detail: See docs/STUDENT_SAMPLE_INTAKE.md for file naming, photo quality, first-pass procedure, verification commands, and report format.

cards.title: Classroom test plan created
cards.summary: Teacher-trust and student-usability criteria are now written down before the real worksheet samples arrive.
cards.detail: See docs/CLASSROOM_TEST_PLAN.md. It defines what the open-divider classroom test should prove, how to rate results, and what not to claim before evidence exists.

cards.title: Worksheet design system drafted
cards.summary: Worksheet rules now capture Tony's clean, paper-first, scan-safe direction for future artifacts.
cards.detail: See docs/WORKSHEET_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md. It documents open-divider guardrails, scan-safe rules, answer-key expectations, product packaging needs, and what Codex must not change without evidence.

cards.title: Current worksheet packet preserved
cards.summary: The active open-divider Grade 2 A/B/C worksheet SVGs and print PDFs are now committed.
cards.detail: This protects the exact packet Tony is using for student samples: Addition Within 20, Subtraction Within 20, and Mixed Within 50.

cards.title: Playwright worksheet fixtures preserved

cards.detail: This keeps test-upload-real.spec.js and export-crops-debug.spec.js reproducible instead of depending on untracked local images.

codex_autonomy_rule: Codex may do read-only inspection, organize Mission Control state, run non-destructive verification, and propose tiny patches. OCR/capture/homography/iPad behavior, cleanup, deployment, and product-direction changes need Tony or reproducible evidence.
